business_problem: replace time-consuming, siloed insurance data management with a secure self-service platform that could scale analytics, mask sensitive data, and accelerate partner and acquisition integration.
solution_summary: Open Insurance uses Snowflake, Streamlit, dbt Labs, and ChatGPT to turn fragmented insurance, customer, and partner data into a governed self-service analytics platform. Transactional data, product information, and inputs from Customer.io, Stripe, CRM systems, and about 10 UK third-party sources are centralized in Snowflake, where common definitions and reusable models are built so teams can query a single source of truth. Streamlit applications replace custom-coded BI dashboards and expose role-based views that mask personally identifiable information, while GPT-powered query experiences translate natural language into SQL and help staff explore data without waiting on the data team. The platform supports partner data sharing, rapid acquisition integration, and faster dashboard delivery across finance, commercial, and leadership teams.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized and governed data platform where insurance, transaction, and partner data are stored and queried.

solution_components.name: Streamlit
solution_components.role: Delivers self-service applications that let staff query and visualize governed data without custom dashboard code.

solution_components.name: dbt Labs
solution_components.role: Standardizes common requests and consistent definitions by modeling data directly in Snowflake.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Supports natural-language query experiences that turn user questions into SQL and summarize results for business users.

data_flow: Customer transactions, product data, and partner-system feeds from tools such as Customer.io, Stripe, CRM platforms, and UK third-party sources land in Snowflake. dbt Labs models the data into consistent business definitions, and Streamlit plus ChatGPT-powered workflows surface governed self-service analytics and dashboard experiences to employees and partner teams.
integration_points: about 10 third-party systems for UK operations
business_outcome: Open Insurance achieved 70% data self-service across the business, cut BI dashboard delivery time by 50%, reduced BI request volume by nearly a third, and integrated 16 acquisition data sources in one month.
metrics: 1 month to integrate 16 data sources from an acquired company
